name: password_check
description: Analyze password strength, generate a strong random password, check if a password appears in known data breaches (Have I Been Pwned), or get AI-suggested memorable strong passwords for a given context.

action.description: analyze_strength: score and feedback for a given password. generate: create a strong random password. check_breach: check if a password has appeared in known data breaches. suggest: AI-generated memorable password ideas for a described context (e.g. 'for my email account').

password.description: The password to analyze or check. Required for analyze_strength and check_breach. Treat this value as sensitive - never echo it back unnecessarily in your reply.

length.description: Desired password length for action='generate'. Defaults to 16.

special_chars.description: Whether to include special characters when generating. Defaults to true.

description.description: What the password is for (e.g. 'my banking app'). Required for action='suggest'.
